name: toolbar
title: Toolbar
summary: A row of controls that act on the current view, reachable with one Tab stop and the arrow keys.
source: Sesama UI (MIT); behaviour from Radix Toolbar (MIT)
use_when: Formatting, filtering or zoom controls over an editor, canvas or table
A group of icon buttons that belong together
avoid_when: Page navigation: use Tabs or Navigation Menu
Two or three unrelated buttons: use Button Group or plain Buttons

copy.button: A verb or a noun in one or two words; icon-only buttons need an aria-label

a11y: One Tab stop: the arrow keys move between controls, Home and End jump to the ends
Give the toolbar an aria-label that says what it acts on
Every icon-only control needs an aria-label
